request: Research official fan-platform/game-currency references before flat redesign; avoid dense clusters; cute, simple style.

sources.kind: Official design-team explanation; historical design rationale
sources.confirmed: Rounded, playful minimal illustrations; few necessary details and clear silhouette/negative space, including small screens.
sources.application: Flat rounded bean silhouettes with restrained detail. This is a design recommendation, not a virtual-currency standard.

sources.kind: Official live public store; rendered browser observation
sources.confirmed: Nine Robux packages reuse a small currency symbol next to explicit amount/price; larger packages do not require a larger pile of individual objects.
sources.application: Keep quantity and KRW labels authoritative; decorative pictures need not literally count beans.

sources.kind: Official public storefront; limited to pre-login promotion
sources.confirmed: Public promotion for gems/offers is visible; live purchase offers require login. Cookie dialog obscures initial screenshot.
sources.application: Currency/package store reference only. No claim that Supercell uses a flat art standard or that all package designs were inspected.

sources.confirmed: Web reader redirects to login; local rendered browser returned403. Current charge package art was not verified.
sources.application: Do not claim Fantrie uses flat currency art, or infer charge screen from third-party screenshots.

sources.confirmed: Use simple schematic icons with fewer details and visible labels to reduce ambiguity.
sources.application: Keep amount/price labels and validate recognition at actual display size.

sources.kind: Official Google icon guide, general UI guidance
sources.confirmed: Simple minimal forms optimized for clarity at both small and large sizes.
sources.application: Consistency/clarity reference; not a binding rule for currency product illustrations.

methods: Web search and official page reads
Chromium public page text/image inventory and screenshots
Manual review of Roblox package screenshot, Duolingo shape-language screenshot, Supercell cookie overlay screenshot

proposal.status: Recommendation only; no generation/UI/deployment this turn
proposal.style: Rounded2Dflat; mint/cream with restrained accent; no realistic wrinkles, bean seams, shine, texture or shadows
proposal.density: At most3 separate bean silhouettes; pouches/boxes remain single closed silhouettes with bean emblem, no overflowing beans

quantities.100: one mini pouch with bean emblem
quantities.500: one pouch with single small star
quantities.1000: one gift box with bean emblem
quantities.10000: one gift box with small star accent

checksBeforeApplication: No crowded repeated beans or tiny decorative texture
All nine amount and KRW labels remain correct
Shared preview/service component and existing order/payment behavior remain intact

limits: No single codified industry standard for virtual currency art was identified.
Reference principles are separated from recommended palette/object count, which are project choices.
No authenticated Fantrie charge screen or current Supercell sale offers inspected.
No customer data, login, payment, generated art, code or production deployment changed.
